title: image_heavy_document
description: Documents made up mostly or entirely of photos, diagrams, or sketches, with little or no running text (any text is just captions, labels, or signs visible in a photo): damage photos, scene diagrams, floor plans. Choose this whenever images are the main content.

figure_descriptions.description: One description per image or diagram: what it shows and any visible damage. Filled in from figure analysis, not text extraction.
